assessment_objectives.objective: the physical security protections required for rooms and/or facilities used to store Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) are defined.
processes exist to define criteria for Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) storage.
Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) are stored in rooms and/or facilities that implement the organization-defined physical security protections.
